title: Why Hornet was born as a bargain in Hollow Knight
subject: hornet
description:
Would you have taken the Pale King's deal? 👇

How Hornet's birth sealed her mother Herrah inside an endless dream. Spoilers for Hollow Knight.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Team Cherry. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Hornet was born as payment for her mother's endless sleep.
The Pale King needed three Dreamers to hold the seal on Hallownest's plague.
One of them was Herrah the Beast, queen of Deepnest. Her price was a child with the king.
Hornet was born, and Herrah lay down in a dream she would never wake from.
The spiders of Deepnest called the girl a child of Wyrm and Weaver.
Years later in Greenpath, a masked stranger crossed her path. She raised her needle and said, "Come no closer, ghost."
She was guarding the kingdom her mother had paid for.
